name: Exchange Rate Type 4 Code
definition: Code used to define the type of the currency exchange.

AGRD.name: Agreed
AGRD.definition: Exchange rate applied is the rate agreed between the parties.

SALE.name: Sale
SALE.definition: Exchange rate applied is the market rate at the time of the sale.

SPOT.name: Spot
SPOT.definition: Exchange rate applied is the spot rate.
